definitions.explanation: A person who draws likenesses or caricatures of people, often quickly at tourist spots, events, or street corners.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}が{絵|え}を{描|か}いていた。
examples.english: A portrait artist was drawing pictures in the park.

examples.japanese: {観光地|かんこうち}には{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}がいることが{多|おお}い。
プロの{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}に{家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}の{絵|え}を{描|か}いてもらった。
examples.english: We had a professional portrait artist draw a picture of the whole family.

notes:
Composed of {似顔絵|にがおえ} (likeness portrait) + {師|し} (a suffix marking a skilled practitioner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}に{描|か}いてもらう: to have a portrait artist draw one
- プロの{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}: a professional caricaturist
- {街頭|がいとう}の{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}: a street portrait artist
